An '''Imperial launch''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. One was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] warship ''[[Eye of the Storm (starship)|Eye of the Storm]]'' for boarding duty over the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tazan]].
